Description: Absorbs damage equal to the amount of stacks. Decays completely at the end of the turn.
Deals damage equal to the amount of stacks at the end of the turn. After dealing damage the value is reduced by half.
Deals damage back to the attacker equal to the amount of stacks. Loses 1 stack per activation.
When this unit dies, it deals collateral damage equal to its Static stacks to living adjacent lineup allies, mitigated by Armor. Stacks decay by 1 at the end of each turn.
